title: Load-generator and measurement validation
purpose: Measure the generator ceiling and timing accuracy; cross-check against ApacheBench 2.3; verify coordinated-omission correction under an injected stall
primary_outcome: Generator throughput ratio SCALE/ab on GET /null at c in {1;8;32}
status: exploratory run (2026-11-24 smoke checks J-0002, J-0003, J-0006, J-0007; not EXP-001 itself); confirmatory run awaits owner freeze
planned_analysis: Median and range over 5 repeats; ratio within [0.9;1.1]; sets generator-limited thresholds for EXP-002 to EXP-004

title: One-factor-at-a-time comparison (closed-loop concurrency sweep)
purpose: Primary: which of cache / index / batching / bounded concurrency changes peak goodput most relative to baseline A0
primary_outcome: Peak goodput G* (validated HTTP 200 per second; max over c in {1;2;4;8;16;32;64}); effect R_j = G*_j / G*_A0
status: planned (protocol draft, awaiting owner freeze); harness implemented at M2
planned_analysis: Geometric mean of within-block R_j over 10 blocks; percentile bootstrap 95% and Bonferroni 98.75% intervals; practical threshold [0.95;1.05]; dominance via pairwise ratios

title: Open-loop SLO goodput (load-model sensitivity)
purpose: Test whether the EXP-002 ranking survives open-loop arrivals with intended-time latency
primary_outcome: SLO goodput S (highest offered rate with intended-time p99 <= 50 ms and errors <= 1%)
status: planned (protocol draft, awaiting owner freeze); harness implemented at M2
planned_analysis: Ranking comparison with EXP-002; bootstrap over 5 blocks of log(S_j/S_A0); SLO 100 ms sensitivity

title: Workload sensitivity (table size and key skew)
purpose: Test whether the dominant bottleneck is an artifact of N and Zipf skew (optional; first cut)
primary_outcome: Top arm and R_j per variant (V1 N=10000; V2 uniform keys)
status: planned (protocol draft, awaiting owner freeze); harness implemented at M2
planned_analysis: As EXP-002 with 5 blocks per variant; 95% intervals only
